svg.aria-label: A CPU with a few large cores and a GPU with hundreds of small ones
svg.title: A CPU with a few large cores and a GPU with hundreds of small ones
svg.text: A few strong workers, or thousands of small ones
a few cores, each does anything
many cores, each does small sums
Training needs huge numbers of small sums at once, which is what a GPU is for. A CPU is enough to run rai’s and RAM’s readers.
